item.title: Carney Has Canadians’ Support on Trump. Now Comes the Hard Part.
item.description: The U.S.-Canada trade war has galvanized Canadians behind their prime minister’s decision to walk away from negotiations. What happens when the time comes for talks to restart?

item.title: Turkey and Israel Vie for Middle East Influence as Tensions Spike
item.description: Israel’s strike on a Syrian base to pre-empt the feared deployment of Turkish forces was part of a growing competition in the Middle East and beyond.

item.title: Israeli Settlers Attack Palestinians, Drawing Sharp Rebukes
item.description: The intensity of Saturday’s assault prompted condemnations from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel and other officials.

item.title: Icelanders Are Voting on E.U. Membership Talks. Here’s What to Know.
item.description: The Nordic nation is holding a referendum on Saturday on whether to start membership talks with the European Union. Voters are divided.

item.title: Six Months In, Iran Appears Stronger and U.S. Goals Unclear
item.description: Trump’s replacement of a military war with a heightened economic one is not expected to alter Iran’s strategy, while further impoverishing its people.

item.title: Nepal Rescuers Bore Through Tunnels to Try to Reach 900 Workers Missing After Floods
item.description: The Nepal Army, which is leading rescue efforts, turned to the trapped workers more than a day after the flood, according to army officials, industry groups and private rescuers.

item.title: Fear Over Malaysia’s Plan to Send Back Rohingya Migrants to Myanmar
item.description: The announcement has sent panic through a community that fled its country’s brutal military rule, civil war, religious persecution or some combination of the three.
